The lever is **Kimi Delta Attention** — a fixed-size memory instead of full KV cache growth with context length. ### How KDA works (plain) | Standard attention | KDA | |---|---| | Every new token attends to **all** past tokens | Keeps **one small fixed-size** memory | | Memory/compute explode at long context | **Delta rule**: erase old key
